005package org.wpilib.telemetry;
006
007/** Exception used to reject collection telemetry logging without an explicit element type. */
008public class CollectionElementTypeRequiredException extends Exception {
009  private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
010
011  /** Constructs a new exception. */
012  public CollectionElementTypeRequiredException() {
013    super("collection element type must be specified");
014  }
015}
